# `orders`
Columns: id, customer, ordered_at, store_id, subtotal, tax_paid, order_total, order_weekday, order_hour
Measures: total_revenue, net_sales, tax_collected, order_count, unique_customers, avg_order_value, effective_tax_rate, sales_weighted_aov
Aggregations: dollars, weighted_avg
Joins to: customers, stores

## demo_database.orders.effective_tax_rate
Measure: demo_database.orders.effective_tax_rate
Formula: tax_paid:sum / nullif(subtotal:sum, 0)
Description: Tax collected as a share of net sales.
Label: Effective Tax Rate

---

## demo_database.orders.net_sales
Measure: demo_database.orders.net_sales
Formula: subtotal:dollars
Description: Sales before tax, in dollars.
Label: Net Sales (pre-tax)

---

## demo_database.orders.tax_collected
Measure: demo_database.orders.tax_collected
Formula: tax_paid:dollars
Description: Total tax collected, in dollars.
Label: Tax Collected

args.message: Collected rate = total tax paid ÷ total pre-tax subtotal across all of each store's orders (the effective_tax_rate measure). Every store collected slightly less than its stated rate. The gaps are largest in Chicago (0.0621 vs 0.0625) and San Francisco (0.0745 vs 0.075).
